disclosure: Sourced from independent reporting on Google's April 2026 Prohibited and Restricted Content policy update

claims.text: Google's April 2026 update explicitly bans merchants from directing staff to solicit a specific number of reviews (quotas)
Google's April 2026 update explicitly bans directing customers to include specific content, including a staff member's name, in a review
Reports describe reviews being quietly removed and profiles picking up restrictions or warning banners under the updated automated enforcement
The policy requires review requests to go to all customers equally rather than selectively
Black Arrow's platform includes an automated review-collection engine that can send requests to every customer the same way
